up: Find all molecule records (chembl_id, pref_name, max_phase, therapeutic_flag, dosed_ingredient, structure_type, molecule_type, first_approval, oral, parenteral, topical, black_box_warning, natural_product, first_in_class, chirality, prodrug, inorganic_flag, usan_year, availability_type, usan_stem, polymer_flag, usan_substem, usan_stem_definition, withdrawn_flag, chemical_probe, orphan, veterinary) that are linked to document CHEMBL5728555. Document CHEMBL5728555 has doc_id = 11788. The link between molecules and documents is via the compound_records table: compound_records.doc_id = CHEMBL5728555 (doc_id) and compound_records.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno. Return the molecule dictionary rows that have at least one associated record in compound_records with doc_id 11788. No additional filters or sorting are required.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    md.chembl_id,
    md.pref_name,
    md.max_phase,
    md.therapeutic_flag,
    md.dosed_ingredient,
    md.structure_type,
    md.molecule_type,
    md.first_approval,
    md.oral,
    md.parenteral,
    md.topical,
    md.black_box_warning,
    md.natural_product,
    md.first_in_class,
    md.chirality,
    md.prodrug,
    md.inorganic_flag,
    md.usan_year,
    md.availability_type,
    md.usan_stem,
    md.polymer_flag,
    md.usan_substem,
    md.usan_stem_definition,
    md.withdrawn_flag,
    md.chemical_probe,
    md.orphan,
    md.veterinary
FROM molecule_dictionary md
JOIN compound_records cr ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
WHERE cr.doc_id = 11788;
